steps.title: Three columns: 100px, 1fr and 2fr
steps.text: `grid-template-columns: repeat(1, 100px 1fr 2fr)` makes a 100 px column, then shares the rest of the 500 px, after two 15 px gaps, as one part and two parts.
steps.textZh: `grid-template-columns: repeat(1, 100px 1fr 2fr)` 先给出 100 px 的一列，再把 500 px 里剩下的部分（减去两个 15 px 的间隙）按一份和两份分给另外两列。

steps.title: grid-auto-flow: column
steps.text: The cells fill each column from top to bottom before moving on, so 1, 2 and 3 stand in the first column. Switch to `row` and they fill the first row instead.
steps.textZh: 格子先从上到下填满一列，再转到下一列，所以 1、2、3 站在第一列。切换成 `row`，它们就改为填满第一行。
steps.actionLabelZh: 在 column 和 row 之间切换

steps.title: Gaps between rows and columns
steps.text: `grid-gap: 20px 15px` leaves 20 px between rows and 15 px between columns. Today the property is called `gap`; browsers still accept the old name.
steps.textZh: `grid-gap: 20px 15px` 在行之间留 20 px，在列之间留 15 px。这个属性今天叫 `gap`，浏览器仍然接受旧名字。

steps.title: Named areas, used by nobody
steps.titleZh: 有名字却没人用的区域
steps.text: `grid-template-areas` names six cells `a`, `c`, `d`, `f`, `g` and `i`, but no cell asks for a name, so the names change nothing. Give cell 9 `grid-area: a` and it moves to the top-left corner.
steps.textZh: `grid-template-areas` 给六个格子起了名字：`a`、`c`、`d`、`f`、`g`、`i`，但没有哪个格子按名字放置，所以这些名字不起作用。给格子 9 设置 `grid-area: a`，它就会移到左上角。
steps.actionLabelZh: 给格子 9 设置 grid-area: a

watch.label: cell 9 is in the top-left corner
